The `/Playlists/{playlistId}/Items` endpoint accepts a `userId` query parameter and uses it as the "calling user" for authorization purposes without verifying that the authenticated caller is allowed to act as that user. As a result, any authenticated non-admin user can read the items of another user's private playlist by adding `?userId=<victim-guid>` to the URL. This can result in information disclosure of private data from one user to another.

### Patches
Fixed in v12.0 via improved authentication checks on the affected endpoint.

### Workarounds
N/A

### References

PoC and report provided by Jeffry Mozalbat (@jeffry55).
